messages:
Sam (AE): Fwd from Ufinity security: they need an ISO excerpt and a signed pen-test attestation. Also asking for a short unauthenticated scan window against staging next Fri 09:00 PDT. Can we support and how long to produce artifacts?
Rina (Solutions Eng): I can pull an ISO excerpt and a minimal network diagram. For the attestation, Legal needs signer/name/title and company registration number. Signed PDF turnaround ~48h after we have fields.
Noah (Security): Unauth scan ok on staging, but we need source IPs, UA, and assurance no creds/keys are exposed. We'll redact any internal ticket links.
Sam (AE): Ufinity secops: security@ufinity.io. They gave two IPs: 52.88.12.7, 52.88.12.8. UA: "UfinityProbe/1.2".
Kai (Infra): We'll accept /32s. Please confirm exact CIDRs and desired open/close times. Also tell us expected request rate so we can avoid autoscaling noise.
Rina (Solutions Eng): CIDRs should be: 52.88.12.7/32 and 52.88.12.8/32. They requested Fri 08:50 PDT open -> 09:30 PDT close. Rate: low, ~10 req/s.
Noah (Security): Low rate OK. We'll log and monitor. Also we require the signed pen-test attestation to reference the exact staging hostnames; please avoid including any prod hostnames.
Sam (AE): Ufinity confirms staging hostnames only and accepts redaction. Sending Legal fields now: signer_name: Marco Li; signer_title: VP Security; company_name: Ufinity Labs LLC; registration_id: 98-7654321; testing_scope: unauthenticated external vuln scan against staging hostnames only; desired_return_email: security@ufinity.io
LegalBot: Received fields. We'll generate the attestation PDF and return signed copy within 48 hours. Please confirm any regulatory clauses Ufinity requires (e.g., extra indemnity).
Sam (AE): Ufinity says standard indemnity fine.
Rina (Solutions Eng): Uploaded ISO excerpt + network diagram + minimal runbook to presigned S3 (24h): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/ufinity/ufinity-package.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400
Noah (Security): I'll review the package, redact any internal-only artifact, and approve for sharing.
Kai (Infra): I'll schedule firewall change to open the two /32s at Fri 08:50 PDT and close at 09:35 PDT with an auto-rollback window. Monitoring enabled.
Sam (AE): Thanks all — passing to Ufinity: security@ufinity.io. Will update when signed attestation arrives. :thumbsup:
